<script type="text/javascript">
    // 1. Configure Intel TMS Layer
    var wapLocalCode = 'us-en'; 
    var wapSection = "ips-portal";
    var wa_env = "prod"; 

    // 2. Load Intel TMS Script Asynchronously
    (function() {
        var url = "https://www.intel.com/content/dam/www/global/wap/tms-loader.js"; 
        var po = document.createElement('script'); 
        po.type = 'text/javascript'; 
        po.async = true;  
        po.src = url;
        console.log('Head Markup test1 po src==' + po.src);
        var s = document.getElementsByTagName('script')[0]; 
        s.parentNode.insertBefore(po, s);			
    })();

    // 3. Isolated Lightning Web Security (LWS) Cross-Sandbox CustomEvent Handshake Bridge
    (function () {
        var CONSENT_KEY = '_wap_user_consent';
        var EVT_OUT = 'consent:update'; // Event sent to your LWC
        var EVT_IN = 'consent:request';  // Event received from your LWC

        function publish() {
            try { 
                var raw = window.localStorage.getItem(CONSENT_KEY);
                if (!raw) return false;
                
                // Dispatches the global storage payload safely into the LWC namespace context
                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(EVT_OUT, { detail: { consent: raw } }));
                return true;
            } catch (e) { 
                return false; 
            }
        }

        // Action A: Instantly answer LWC components that mount late and request the value
        window.addEventListener(EVT_IN, publish);

        // Action B: Poll active window storage until tms-loader fetches & writes the consent data
        var tries = 0;
        var timer = setInterval(function () {
            if (publish() || ++tries >= 40) { 
                clearInterval(timer); // Safeguard timeout exit boundary reached (~10 seconds)
            } 
        }, 250);
    })();
</script>
